entities.name: Sir Francis Drake
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: English sea captain, privateer, and navigator (c. 1540–1596) who completed the second circumnavigation of the Earth (1577–1580) and played a key role in defeating the Spanish Armada in 1588. To the English he was a hero; to the Spanish, "El Draque" was a feared pirate who raided their Pacific and Caribbean possessions.
